Clear snow from vehicle
Dynamic Vehicle Snow
Maximum snow accumulation temperature (×0.1 °C)
Maximum temperature at which snow may accumulate. Stored in tenths of a degree: 0 = 0 °C, -20 = -2 °C, 15 = +1.5 °C.
Engine snow melting
Allows a running engine to reduce Snow3 to Snow2 after warming up.
Engine warm-up time (game minutes)
Game minutes the engine must run continuously at Snow3 before Snow3 → Snow2.
Snow melting: minutes per stage

Melting time is doubled by default. Base setting: 180 minutes per stage. Temperature curve for Snow3 → Clean: +1 °C ≈ 540 min, +5 °C ≈ 420, +10 °C ≈ 270, +15 °C ≈ 140, +25 °C ≈ 120. Snow3 → Snow2 → Snow1 → Clean remains sequential.
Melting start temperature (×0.1 °C)
Snow starts melting above this temperature. Value is in tenths of a degree: 10 = +1.0 °C. Default: +1 °C.
Snow1: time to first stage (game minutes)
Time from the start of maximum snowfall to Snow1. Default: 60 minutes.
Snow2: total time to second stage (game minutes)
Total time from the start of maximum snowfall to Snow2. Default: 180 minutes (3 hours).
Snow3: total time to third stage (game minutes)
Total time from the start of maximum snowfall to Snow3. Default: 360 minutes (6 hours).
Use snowfall intensity
Enabled: configured Snow1/Snow2/Snow3 times are for maximum snowfall; lighter snowfall accumulates more slowly. Disabled: configured times are used without intensity slowdown.
